g.text: Swizzle sweeps S=2 M-tiles before advancing N, so both an A-strip and a B-column stay live in L2 —

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: pure row- or column-major only ever keeps ONE of the two matrices' tiles warm.
